db:select.doc:name: SELECT Order Header
db:select.db:sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, status, sync_status, total, currency, salesforce_id, sync_attempts, last_sync_error, created_at, updated_at FROM retail_orders WHERE order_id = :orderId

db:select.doc:name: SELECT Order Items
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, quantity, unit_price, subtotal FROM retail_order_items WHERE order_id = :orderId ORDER BY id ASC

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var h = vars.orderHeader[0] --- { orderId: h.order_id, status: h.status, syncStatus: h.sync_status, total: h.total as Number, currency: h.currency, customer: { customerId: h.customer_id, name: h.customer_name, email: h.customer_email }, salesforceId: h.salesforce_id, syncAttempts: h.sync_attempts as Number, lastSyncError: h.last_sync_error, items: (vars.orderItems default []) map (item) -> { sku: item.sku, quantity: item.quantity as Number, unitPrice: item.unit_price as Number, subtotal: item.subtotal as Number }, createdAt: (h.created_at as DateTime default now()) >> "UTC", updatedAt: (h.updated_at as DateTime default now()) >> "UTC" }

db:select.doc:name: SELECT Orders by Sync Status
db:select.db:sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, status, sync_status, total, currency, salesforce_id, sync_attempts, last_sync_error, created_at, updated_at FROM retail_orders WHERE sync_status = :status ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT :limitRows

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" --- payload map (row) -> { orderId: row.order_id, status: row.status, syncStatus: row.sync_status, total: row.total as Number, currency: row.currency, customer: { customerId: row.customer_id, name: row.customer_name, email: row.customer_email }, salesforceId: row.salesforce_id, syncAttempts: row.sync_attempts as Number, lastSyncError: row.last_sync_error, createdAt: (row.created_at as DateTime default now()) >> "UTC", updatedAt: (row.updated_at as DateTime default now()) >> "UTC" }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var skus = payload.items.*sku default [] --- sizeOf(skus) != sizeOf(skus distinctBy $)

db:select.doc:name: Check Existing OrderId
db:select.db:sql: SELECT order_id FROM retail_orders WHERE order_id = :orderId

raise-error.doc:name: Raise ORDER_ALREADY_EXISTS (409)
raise-error.description: #['La orden ' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' ya existe en PostgreSQL.']

db:select.doc:name: SELECT Product FOR UPDATE
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, product_name, unit_price, stock, active FROM products WHERE sku = :sku FOR UPDATE

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INSUFFICIENT_STOCK (409)
raise-error.description: #['Inventario insuficiente para completar la orden en el SKU: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku]

db:update.doc:name: UPDATE Deduct Stock Conditional
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE products SET stock = stock - :quantity, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku = :sku AND stock >= :quantity

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INSUFFICIENT_STOCK (409)
raise-error.description: #['No se pudo descontar stock para el SKU: ' ++ vars.currentItem.sku]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var unitPrice = vars.dbProduct[0].unit_price as Number var qty = vars.currentItem.quantity as Number --- vars.enrichedItems + { sku: vars.currentItem.sku, quantity: qty, unitPrice: unitPrice, subtotal: (qty * unitPrice) as Number }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- sum(vars.enrichedItems.subtotal default [0]) as Number

db:insert.doc:name: INSERT Order Header
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO retail_orders ( order_id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, status, sync_status, total, currency, sync_attempts ) VALUES ( :orderId, :customerId, :customerName, :customerEmail, 'CREATED', 'PENDING_SYNC', :total, 'MXN', 0 )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderId, customerId: vars.orderReq.customer.customerId, customerName: vars.orderReq.customer.name, customerEmail: vars.orderReq.customer.email, total: vars.orderTotal }]

db:insert.doc:name: INSERT Order Line
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderId, sku: payload.sku, quantity: payload.quantity, unitPrice: payload.unitPrice, subtotal: payload.subtotal }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.orderId, status: "CREATED", syncStatus: "PENDING_SYNC", total: vars.orderTotal as Number, currency: "MXN", customer: vars.orderReq.customer, items: vars.enrichedItems, syncAttempts: 0, createdAt: now() >> "UTC", updatedAt: now() >> "UTC", message: "Orden guardada en PostgreSQL; sincronizacion con Salesforce pendiente." }

on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue - Map Domain Errors

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var errId = error.errorType.identifier default "INTERNAL_ERROR" var status = if (errId == "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND") 404 else if (errId == "PRODUCT_INACTIVE") 400 else if (errId == "ORDER_ALREADY_EXISTS" or errId == "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK") 409 else if (errId == "CONNECTIVITY") 503 else 500 --- { success: false, error: { code: errId, message: error.description default "Error procesando la transaccion en PostgreSQL.", httpStatus: status, correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId } }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var errId = error.errorType.identifier default "INTERNAL_ERROR" --- if (errId == "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND") 404 else if (errId == "PRODUCT_INACTIVE") 400 else if (errId == "ORDER_ALREADY_EXISTS" or errId == "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK") 409 else if (errId == "CONNECTIVITY") 503 else 500

db:update.doc:name: UPDATE Order Sync Status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE retail_orders SET sync_status = :syncStatus, salesforce_id = COALESCE(:salesforceId, salesforce_id), last_sync_error = :lastSyncError, sync_attempts = CASE WHEN :syncAttempted = TRUE THEN sync_attempts + 1 ELSE sync_attempts END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = :orderId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderId, syncStatus: vars.syncUpdateReq.syncStatus, salesforceId: vars.syncUpdateReq.salesforceId default null, lastSyncError: vars.syncUpdateReq.lastSyncError default null, syncAttempted: (vars.syncUpdateReq.syncAttempted default true) as Boolean }]
